name: Render
description: Static sites, Node and Python services, Docker services for .NET and Java, and Render Postgres.

specSections.title: Environments & Configuration
specSections.guidance: Per environment (production services auto-deploying main; preview = <name>-preview services and database): each service's type, runtime, root directory, health path, pre-deploy (or start-time on free plans) migrate command and URL, the database (Render Postgres, internal DATABASE_URL), every env var per service, and the origin model (static-site /api route set by AIDE, or cross-origin). Note free-plan sleep and 30-day database expiry.

checklist.item: Each Docker service has a multi-stage Dockerfile with a non-root USER and a .dockerignore, and listens on 0.0.0.0:$PORT
The image or build output contains the data pack's one-off migrate command for the pre-deploy
Free instances run the migrate command at container start and exit non-zero when it fails
The backend's ready health path exists and checks the database
The backend handles Render's postgres:// DATABASE_URL format
Any render.yaml is marked as documentation, mirrors the resources AIDE creates and uses sync: false or generateValue instead of literal secrets
No CI job, script or package script deploys with the Render CLI; AIDE triggers every deploy
.env.example lists every variable the app needs, with placeholders only
